name: numera-video-sub-finder
description: Extract burned-in subtitles locally, resume batches, and review or export subtitle projects with the nvsf CLI.

interface.longDescription: Check local OCR resources, extract subtitles from one video or a queue, and edit saved cues before exporting.
defaultPrompt: Extract the burned-in subtitles from this video into an SRT file.
Check whether my local OCR setup is ready for this language.
List cues that need review in this .nvsf project.
